propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to error and surface INDETERMINATE verdicts on unrelated tickets whose relation graph walks through it.

Empty ticket directories (created before the first event is written) persist invisibly in local clones, cannot be tracked by git, and cause the plan-review gate to fail closed without running the LLM.

The plan-relation snapshot reducer must skip event-less directories with a warning rather than failing the entire snapshot, and must preserve error behavior for genuinely corrupt directories that hold partial or unreadable events.

The ticket writer creates the directory before writing its first event, and this writer-side behavior is intentional because it is unsafe to clean up directories under the store's concurrent multi-session model and cannot repair existing broken clones.
